vsam.why: hc-file-unlock: hcuf.txt records, 4-byte key, 16-byte records (CSD DEFINE FILE has a DSNAME, no IDCAMS)

notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-file-unlock (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): READ UPDATE / REWRITE / UNLOCK on a KSDS (K001..K003); REWRITE after UNLOCK, UNLOCK with nothing held, READ INTO with LENGTH below the record (LENGERR). Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs. Scenarios U (UNLOCK after READ UPDATE) and N (UNLOCK with nothing held) are left out: the det port records an UNLOCK event (#7569) that the equivalence oracle stub does not log, so the side-by-side event lists differ (harness gap, #6271).
